name: libr_water_absorption_chiller
title: LiBr-water absorption chiller cycle with a solution heat exchanger
summary: Single-effect LiBr-H2O absorption chiller at one operating point: solution concentrations from the EES built-in X_LIBR/H_LIBR routines, mass and LiBr conservation for the weak/rich solution flow rates, generator energy balance for the driving heat and the COP, 75 % solution heat exchanger.
language_features: EES built-in LiBr solution routines X_LIBR and H_LIBR

authors: TBD (ULiège MSTh course: J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio)
origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition 11 (LiBr-H2O absorption chiller), exercise 2

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the original file TM-0167 (30/30 variables), reported in the README as the target for the re-check; the model does not solve in CoolSolve, so no comparison was made
verification.notes: Blocked, not verified. coolsolve ./libr_water_absorption_chiller.eescode -> Block 16 failed: Unknown or unsupported function: X_LIBR with 3 arguments (gap CS-GAP-FLUIDS-ABS, already registered for the CoolSolve example water_libr). The system is square (46 equations / 46 variables, largest block 3); the water-side property calls are supported.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/water_libr.eescode (verbatim transcription of the same original, kept as test case for CS-GAP-FLUIDS-ABS)
